cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Delegate Downward
cards.instruction: Make someone accept an unwanted responsibility by placing them lower in the hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. As junior coordinator, you're responsible for the blocked sink. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ran the whole event yesterday. You said I'd earned a promotion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. To senior coordinator. Still below me, but now you can supervise the plumber.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He can only come after everyone leaves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll lock up too. I can't give building security to a junior.

mechanism: A assigns an unwanted sink duty through a lower coordinator rank, offering a promotion and practical conditions to keep B accepting the subordinate responsibility.
confusable: Unlike merely recruiting general help, the hierarchy justifies dumping a specific unwelcome task; borrowed authority must concede terms while preserving lower rank.
comparison: Event sink/plumber/late lockup differs from a deputy representing a superior over disputed inspection decisions.
seedUse: Use D53-a junior/senior/plumber/lockup and S02-a reframing B-driven concessions as a planned promotion.
